market_question: Will the price of Bitcoin be above $86,000 on May 18?
reasoning: Bitcoin currently trades near $65k, and a 2-year horizon renders an $86k target only ~32% higher. Under typical BTC volatility (annualized 80%), the lognormal probability of spot above $86k on a specific future date is ~40%. The market's implied 0.2% is a severe mispricing likely due to thin liquidity or stale order.
evidence_points: Current BTC/USDT price ~$65k, so a move to $86k in 2 years requires ~15% annualized growth, well within historical norms.
Using 80% annualized vol over 2 years, prob. of log return > ln(86/65) ≈ 0.28 is ~40% (normal CDF).
Even with crash risks, a >100x deviation from that estimate (market implied 0.2%) is implausible.
